## About
Courtesy Car Care is Bob Minnick's repair shop on Big Stone Gap Rd in Duncanville. We put "Courtesy" in our name because we believe good manners matter in business, and we know car repairs are never convenient. Our ASE certified mechanics work on automotive and light truck electrical and mechanical problems, and we keep our tools and equipment current so we can diagnose your car accurately.
We won't quote prices over the phone, because we need to see your car first. Once we do, you get a written estimate for parts and labor. If we find something else along the way, we call you, explain it and give you options. We keep your worn parts so we can show you where the problem was and talk about how to avoid it next time.
We're a member of the Better Business Bureau, and our promise is simple: be fair, be honest and work hard to earn your trust. One reviewer put it this way: "Bob is honest and fixes things right."

## Services
- Brakes and alignment: Brake work and wheel alignment, done after we've looked at your car in person.
- Oil and filter change: Oil and filter change, including the air cleaner.
- Transmission service: Transmission fluid flush and fill.
- Tires and rims: Tire and rim sales, mounting, balancing and rotation.
- Tune-ups: Tune-ups for all years, makes and models.
- Automotive electrical and mechanical: All kinds of automotive electrical and mechanical work.
- Drive line and 4-wheel drive: Drive line and 4-wheel drive diagnosis and repair.
- Suspension repair: Repair of suspension components.
- Fleet services: Service that keeps your work vehicles on the road and working.

## FAQ
Q: Can you give me a price over the phone?
A: No. Car repair has a lot of variables, so we need to see your car to diagnose the problem. After that, we'll give you a written estimate.

Q: What happens if you find another problem during the repair?
A: We'll contact you, explain the problem, offer repair options, and write up an estimate and work order for the additional repairs before doing them.

Q: What if my car needs a tow?
A: For towing, please call J&S Towing at 214-333-9420.
